You are the planning module of a tabletop robot. Task specification: Move the red_block to the purple_box and the green_mug to the cyan_tray. Before placing each object, check that its target zone is unoccupied. If a zone is occupied, move the existing object first, prioritizing the red_block's destination (purple_box) if a conflict arises. Success is confirmed when both objects are correctly placed in their designated zones and no object remains on a zone other than its assigned one.
Goals: [{"object": "red_block", "zone": "purple_box"}, {"object": "green_mug", "zone": "cyan_tray"}]

{"table_z": 0.8, "objects": {"red_block": {"kind": "block", "center": [-0.0913, -0.1784, 0.8199], "top_z": 0.8399, "height": 0.0399, "footprint_long": 0.04, "footprint_short": 0.0394, "long_axis_yaw": 1.03}, "green_mug": {"kind": "mug", "center": [-0.1016, 0.2294, 0.835], "top_z": 0.87, "height": 0.07, "footprint_long": 0.0528, "footprint_short": 0.0456, "long_axis_yaw": -1.119}}, "zones": {"orange_tray": {"name": "orange_tray", "center": [0.0482, 0.2503, 0.8], "half_size": [0.0668, 0.0649]}, "cyan_tray": {"name": "cyan_tray", "center": [-0.0148, 0.0649, 0.8], "half_size": [0.0668, 0.0649]}, "purple_box": {"name": "purple_box", "center": [0.0352, -0.1168, 0.8], "half_size": [0.0575, 0.0538]}}, "gripper": {"width": 0.0796, "closed_command": false, "holding_something": false}, "end_effector": {"position": [-0.198, -0.0004, 1.0796], "yaw": 1.527}}

Order the goals into steps. A zone that is covered by an object must be cleared first (move that
object to its own destination). Skip objects that are already resting on their target zone.
Reply with JSON only:
{"steps": [{"object": "<object name>", "zone": "<zone name>"}, ...]}
